HP 100%: 100% speed. HP 50-99%: 80% speed (x1.25 interval). HP <50%: 50% speed (x2 interval). Applies to fire/recharge/produce cycles.
Tile influence = base * max(0, 1 - 0.2*distance). Sum per player. Highest score owns the tile. Tie = Contested (no owner, unbuildable).
Drag from any owned RL/Barracks/Drone/Militia to a tile. Assigned target used when in range; otherwise AutoRule kicks in. Clear Target button returns to AUTO.
AAS only intercepts rockets/airstrikes. Ground fire from Barracks/Drone/Militia CANNOT be intercepted.
